content: Discuss management rollover if approved by Special Committee

right.name: side tabs
right.use_when: Investment thesis pillars: bold claim + evidence -> so what -> implication (35+ words per pillar)
right.dont_use_when: Short facts or one-liners (use pill_rows); a process (use chevrons)

picked.name: bullets
picked.use_when: Numbered commentary beside an exhibit: bold lead-in + evidence + so what, 2-6 points
picked.dont_use_when: The main exhibit of a page (pick a chart, table or diagram); more than 2 bullet blocks on one slide

why: 3 short text points on approval and timing are commentary beside the offer exhibit, not a visual on their own

message: Unstructured data growing twice as fast as structured creates a large data management opportunity

content: Data needing protection vs actually protected
2020 need equals entire digital universe of 2018

right.name: line
right.use_when: Prices, rates or indices over many periods

picked.name: column
picked.use_when: Market size or volumes over time, or a few series side by side
picked.dont_use_when: Shares of a whole (use stacked / rings)

why: Market volume in EB over 2010-2020 with few labelled points is market size over time; fewer than 6 points rules out line

message: Management forecast shows capex shifting to Renewables with EBITDA and EPS growth to 2035

right.name: fin chart
right.use_when: One metric's trend with CAGR, actual / estimate split and a % margin strip
right.dont_use_when: Several unrelated metrics (use fin_table); two forecast cases compared (use bk11); 2-4 metrics or segments each needing its own chart (use bk36)

picked.name: 2x2 chart dashboard
picked.use_when: Historical / projected summary as 2-4 small charts, one per metric or segment (e.g. revenue, EBITDA, segment EBITDA with CAGRs), or market data in 2-4 panels

why: 12-year EPS series is one of several metrics (capex, EBITDA, EPS) in the message, so a 2x2 chart dashboard panel; fin_chart if shown alone

message: Minority squeeze-out deals were completed at meaningful premiums to undisturbed prices

content: Premiums sorted by size for precedent squeeze-out transactions
Premium to undisturbed price on day before announcement

right.name: table
right.use_when: Labelled numbers that need exact reading: comps, precedents, sources & uses, deal terms, one-way sensitivities (down / base / up), KPI lists with change vs prior period, requirements with detail
right.dont_use_when: A trend over time (use a chart); ranking many players on one metric (use bar); 3-6 headline numbers with no extra columns (use stat_strip)

why: Premiums paid in precedent squeeze-outs vs undisturbed price and 52-week high is a premiums-paid page
